scenes.spoken_script: Why does Posey's public checkbook show a pattern nobody's explaining in plain language?
The county's own public servers show something that doesn't match how normal budgets look.

One weird line in a budget can be nothing. A cluster of weird lines in the same year is why auditors — and taxpayers — start asking questions on the record. The flagged line: Total Gateway disbursements 2024→2025: -15.4% ($239,198,131 → $202,332,583). Taxpayers fund every line. Could be innocent — but it's public money and the explanation should be on the record.
